The weighted campus energy balance calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the risk-assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.80 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully in 0.338s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check the weighting assumptions to ensure the 0.20 gap in judge reward isn't due to edge-case handling.
